# Mumbai Photographers Recommend Their Go-To Places For Camera Rentals

By Mihika

**2968** Interested |

**6\.3K** Views

A long due trip with the entire squad. An award-winning short film script that has been lying idle on paper. A gig that went off superbly. All this and more iconic moments in life get captured in a compromised manner only for the lack of proper gear. But not if you know where to hire the right kind of equipment from. DSLRs, tripods, GoPros, lenses, Osmo and even the more complex set of things, these places will help you with exactly what you might need.

## Bragpacker, Juhu

[### Bragpacker, Juhu, Mumbai](https://lbb.in/places/Bragpacker-juhu-36036f) [See On Map](https://maps.google.com/maps?daddr=19.114524, 72.82437900000002)

[VISIT SITE](http://www.bragpacker.com/?utm_source=LBB&ref=lbbpost)

Bragpacker lets you rent equipment at affordable per day prices in a smooth manner.

...

If your requirement is slightly more professional and involves elaborate set up, Paxton is where you should be headed. With all the leading production houses on their client list, they have every single thing you’ll need. So select, book, pick it up, and get rolling as the world awaits to get captured.

Visit their website [here](http://paxtonequips.com/?utm_source=LBB&ref=lbbpost) .

## Accord Equips, Jogeshwari East

[### Accord Equips, Jogeshwari, Mumbai](https://lbb.in/places/Accord-Equips-jogeshwari-3605b6) [See On Map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&map_action=map&query=Accord%20Equips%2C%20A-9%2C%20Ground%20Floor%2C%20139-G%2C%20Agarwal%20Indl%20Estate%2C%20SV%20Road%2C%20Jogeshwari%20West%2C%20Mumbai)

[VISIT SITE](http://www.accordequips.com/?utm_source=LBB&ref=lbbpost)

Accord Equips doesn’t just rent out equipment, they provide solutions. With Accord you can dare to choose even the complex gear, as they help you with a crew as well.
They love regular student crowd and are often happy to work up some discounts.

Visit their website [here](http://www.accordequips.com/about_us.php?utm_source=LBB&ref=lbbpost) .

## ToeHold, Kurla West

[### Toehold, Kurla, Mumbai](https://lbb.in/places/Toehold-kurla-3606ef) [See On Map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&map_action=map&query=Toehold%2C%20Phoenix%20Market%20City%2C%20S-30%2C%202nd%20Floor%2C%20Lal%20Bahadur%20Shastri%20Road%2C%20Kurla%20West%2C%20Mumbai)

[BOOK HERE](https://www.toehold.in/academy/photography-workshop-mumbai/?ref=lbb&utm_source=LBB&ref=lbbpost#!/book)

If you’re the loyalist kinds, register with Toehold – a one time registration valid for a lifetime. They need a list of documents that need submitting. But the up side of going through this process? They have offices in Bangalore, Pune and Mumbai which means at least in these three cities, you won’t have to ever think before renting equipment.

Visit their website [here](https://www.toehold.
in/rentals/mumbai/?utm_source=LBB&ref=lbbpost) .

## 1 Stop Cine Digital, Andheri West

[### 1 Stop Cine Digital, Andheri West, Mumbai](https://lbb.in/places/1-Stop-Cine-Digital-andheri-west-6d5fdd) [See On Map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&map_action=map&query=1%20Stop%20Cine%20Digital%2C%20Swati%20Building%2C%20Ground%20Floor%2C%201%2F1%2C%20Jain%20Mandir%20Lane%2C%20Andheri%20West%2C%20Mumbai)

[Call (+918691000089)](tel:+918691000089)

If you belong to the restless lot and have no patience for registrations and paperwork, 1 Stop Cone Digital is your haven. They will only seek basic info, and rent out the equipment. Massive believers of efficiency, you can request for the range and price details on WhatsApp and they’ll happily share the document with you.

Contact them on +91 09594470007
